# TEKJEE

> 24/7 Live Virtual Camera Monitoring, AI Automation, and Digital Transformation Solutions for US & UK Businesses.

TEKJEE provides real-time, proactive video surveillance, AI workflow automation, CRM automation, and back-office outsourcing. We specialize in safeguarding physical facilities — including gas stations, commercial warehouses, retail stores, restaurants and hospitality venues — with rapid response times (under 60 seconds) and scalable technology solutions.

## Core Services

- [Digital Marketing](https://tekjee.com/virtual-marketing.html): Social media management, email and content campaigns, SEO, Local SEO, and paid advertising, planned, run and reported for businesses without an in-house marketing team.
- [Virtual Camera Monitoring](https://tekjee.com/camera-monitoring.html): 24/7 live and remote video surveillance, AI video monitoring, motion alerts, and secure cloud or NVR storage, with emergency dispatch.
- [AI Automation & Agentic AI](https://tekjee.com/ai-automation.html): Custom AI bots, a Virtual Manager, autonomous business agents, and AI workflow automation.
- [CRM Automation](https://tekjee.com/crm-automation.html): CRM workflow automation, automated lead capture, automated multi-channel follow-ups, and sales pipeline optimization.
- [Back Office Support](https://tekjee.com/back-office-support.html): Remote administration, transaction monitoring, data entry, and scalable outsourced operational support.
- Web Development: Fast, responsive, custom-designed websites and web apps built in-house for lead generation and online sales.
- SEO & GEO: Local SEO, Technical SEO, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) so a business ranks on Google and is cited by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity.

## Target Industries
- Gas Stations & Convenience Stores
- Commercial Warehouses & Logistics Hubs
- Retail Stores & Shopping Plazas
- Restaurants & Fast-Food Chains
- Hotels & Motels

## Key Performance Metrics
- **Emergency Dispatch Time:** Under 60 seconds
- **Cost Reduction:** Up to 70% savings compared to physical security guards
- **Operational Availability:** 24/7/365 uninterrupted cloud and monitoring center coverage
